title: Greenland says 'no thanks' to Trump's hospital ship
summary: Greenland's Prime Minister Jens-Frederik Nielsen said on ​Sunday "no thanks" to U.S. President Donald Trump's idea of sending a hospital ship to Greenland, a territory that Trump has ​repeatedly ‌said he wishes to take over.
